rules: You are one of many parallel agents building 'Iskra', a Polish-language web app for the HackYeah 2026 HubMI.pl task (ROPS Kraków). The deadline is hard (11:00 CEST), so be fast and pragmatic. A thin but working feature beats a perfect one that isn't finished.
Repo: {repo}. The research and plan are in {research} (read 08-iskra-task-plan.md §2 for the architecture, and 05-accessibility-ux.md for UX rules if you build UI).

FILE OWNERSHIP: you may create or edit ONLY the paths listed in your WP's 'owns'. You may read anything. Frozen shared files (lib/contracts.ts, lib/db/schema.ts, lib/ai/*, components/ui/*, components/shell/*, lib/nav.ts, app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, package.json, configs) must NOT be edited. If you need a change, describe it in 'contract_requests' in your final output and work around it.

NEVER run: pnpm install/add/remove, next build, next dev, a full 'tsc', git commit/push/checkout/stash, vercel, drizzle-kit push. These are run by the lead only. Shared processes already running: 'tsc --watch' writes to .tsc-watch.log, and 'next dev' serves http://localhost:3000.

Typecheck with: pnpm check:owned <your paths...>. It reads .tsc-watch.log and reports only errors in your files, so wait about 5 s after saving. Unit tests: pnpm vitest run <your test files> (keep tests co-located as *.test.ts in your owned paths). UI check: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/<route> must be 200, and curl the HTML for your expected Polish heading. Optional: pnpm playwright test e2e/<WP-ID>.spec.ts --workers=1.

If you depend on another WP's module that is not done yet, import it from its path anyway. The foundation created typed stubs that return fixtures, and the real implementation will replace them at the same path and signature.

UI rules: Polish copy, plain language (≤15 words per sentence, concrete verbs on buttons). Use only components/ui/* and design tokens: no raw colours, ≥44px targets, visible labels plus hints, inline errors with an error summary starting 'Błąd:', and a single <h1>. Announce dynamic results through <StatusRegion>. Wrap every AI output in <AiLabel>. Never use colour alone. Every chart or map needs a <TableWithCaption> equivalent.

AI rules: call models ONLY through lib/ai/gateway.ts (aiObject/aiText/embedTexts). Each call needs an 'offline' fallback for AI_MODE=off. In unit tests, mock the gateway. Make at most 2 live AI calls in total for your own verification. Always pass text through redact() before any AI call or DB write of user text.
Data rules: no real personal data. Seeded or demo rows set synthetic=true. ROPS library content is credited 'Źródło: ROPS Kraków, Biblioteka Innowacji Społecznych' with the licence and a link.

Finish by returning the structured result: id, status (done | partial | blocked), files you changed, the verify commands you ran with pass/fail, contract_requests, and short notes. Do not claim a check passed unless you ran it.

wps.title: Scaffold, all dependencies, configs, shared processes
wps.spec: Create the Next.js app (App Router, TS, Tailwind, ESLint, src-less, pnpm) at {repo}. If the repo dir already exists as a git clone, scaffold into it. Install ALL deps once: ai, zod, drizzle-orm, @neondatabase/serverless, drizzle-kit, minisearch, clsx, tailwind-merge, @radix-ui/react-* (dialog, radio-group, select, checkbox, popover, tabs, accordion), lucide-react, vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8, jsdom, @testing-library/react, playwright, @playwright/test, @axe-core/playwright, tsx. Add vercel.json {"regions":["fra1"]}. .gitignore must cover .env*, .vercel, .next, node_modules, .tsc-watch.log, test-results, playwright-report. Package scripts: dev, build, start, lint, typecheck (tsc --noEmit), 'tsc:watch' (tsc --noEmit --watch --preserveWatchOutput --pretty false > .tsc-watch.log 2>&1), 'check:owned' (scripts/check-owned.ts: reads the last completed cycle in .tsc-watch.log and prints errors whose path starts with any given arg, exiting 1 if any), test (vitest run), e2e (playwright test), db:push (drizzle-kit push), seed (tsx scripts/seed-db.ts). Add vitest.config.ts (jsdom for *.test.tsx, node otherwise, pool threads maxThreads 2), playwright.config.ts (baseURL http://localhost:3000, workers 1, chromium only) and e2e/helpers.ts (axeCheck(page) asserting 0 serious/critical violations with tags wcag2a/aa, wcag21a/aa, wcag22aa). Create empty dirs for app/(public), app/admin, lib/match, lib/db/q, components, scripts, data, e2e, docs. next.config: eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds=true (lint runs separately via pnpm lint, so it never blocks a deploy) and output default. Keep TypeScript build errors ON.
wps.verify: pnpm build passes; pnpm vitest run --passWithNoTests passes; git check-ignore .env.local prints the path; node -e "require('./package.json').scripts['check:owned']" is set.

wps.title: Design system + accessible app shell
wps.spec: Tokens from research 05 §3.8 as CSS variables (text #1B1B1B, primary #0052A5, primary-hover #006CD7, danger #A7162D, success #16692C, muted #656565, border #767676, surface #F1F1F1, a high-contrast theme of #FFFF00 on #000, focus ring 3px), base 18px, line-height 1.5. Iskra wordmark: text plus a small inline-SVG spark, with no gov.pl or herb. components/ui: Button (variants primary/secondary/link, min-h 44px), Field (label + hint + error, ids wired with aria-describedby), TextInput, Textarea, Select, RadioGroup (fieldset/legend), Checkbox, Card, Badge, StatusRegion (role=status, visually hidden option), AiLabel (wraps children with the badge 'Odpowiedź przygotowała sztuczna inteligencja – może zawierać błędy'), Notice (info/warn/success), ErrorSummary, PageHeader (one h1 + lead), StepIndicator ('Krok X z Y' as text), TableWithCaption, Disclaimer, VisuallyHidden. components/shell: Header (Iskra wordmark, nav from lib/nav.ts, ETR and PJM links, a <Bell/> slot importing components/shell/Bell.tsx stub, RoleSwitcher labelled 'Tryb demo – rola'), Footer (links: Deklaracja dostępności, O projekcie i AI, Źródła danych, ROPS Kraków institutional contact), SkipLink 'Przejdź do treści głównej', DisplaySettings panel (A / A+ / A++ text size and high-contrast toggle, persisted in localStorage inside try/catch), RouteFocus (moves focus to h1 and updates document.title on navigation). lib/nav.ts: public nav (Zgłoś potrzebę /zglos, Biblioteka /biblioteka, Wyzwania /wyzwania, Wiedza /wiedza, Zgłoś pomysł /pomysl, Wdrożenie /wdrozenie, Testuj /testuj, Wiadomości /wiadomosci) and admin nav (Skrzynka /admin, Trendy /admin/trendy, Luki /admin/luki, Biblioteka /admin/biblioteka, Nabory /admin/nabory, Poczta /admin/poczta, Testy /admin/testy, Koszty AI /admin/koszty-ai). app/layout.tsx: <html lang="pl">, landmarks, Open Sans or system font. The Bell stub renders a link to /wiadomosci with aria-label 'Powiadomienia'.
wps.verify: pnpm check:owned app/layout.tsx components/ lib/nav.ts; a contrast unit test in components/ui/tokens.test.ts (text pairs ≥4.5, borders and focus ≥3); curl http://localhost:3000/ contains lang="pl" and 'Przejdź do treści głównej'.

wps.title: Database schema + client + push
wps.spec: Drizzle schema for Neon Postgres, using DATABASE_URL from .env.local. Tables, each with id (text uuid default), created_at, and synthetic boolean default false where user-generated: sessions(id, role); innovations(id text pk e.g. rops-001, title, summary, problem, target_groups text[], obszar, type, evidence, who_can_use, sections jsonb, video_urls text[], materials_zip text, source_url, licence, attribution, keywords text[], embedding real[] null, status text default 'opublikowana', seeking_testers boolean default false, edited_at); reports(id, session_id, author_role, on_behalf boolean, helper_role, gmina_teryt, powiat_teryt, text_redacted, structured jsonb, picks jsonb, candidate_ids text[], luka boolean, status text default 'nowe'); ideas(id, session_id, author_role, from_report_id, title, fiszka jsonb, kanwa jsonb, assessment jsonb, grant_draft jsonb, call_id, status text default 'nowe'); calls(id, name, active boolean, opens_at, closes_at, description); threads(id, subject_type text in report|idea|innovation|middleman, subject_id, title, author_session_id, mentor text null); messages(id, thread_id, author_role, author_session_id, body); notifications(id, recipient text ('rops' or 'session:<id>'), type, ref, title, read_at null); email_log(id, to_label, subject, body); test_signups(id, innovation_id, session_id, role, gmina_teryt, message); ratings(id, innovation_id, session_id, stars int, feedback, improvement); middleman_cards(id, innovation_id, session_id, profile jsonb, card jsonb, uw jsonb); ai_audit(id, kind, model, input_tokens int, output_tokens int, ms int, ok boolean). lib/db/client.ts exports db (neon-http). lib/db/q/_shared.ts exports small helpers (newId). Run drizzle-kit push (you ARE allowed to run db:push for this WP only).
wps.verify: pnpm db:push exits 0; a tsx one-liner counting information_schema.tables in public returns ≥14; pnpm check:owned lib/db/.

wps.title: Contracts, AI gateway, session, stubs for every module, route skeletons
wps.spec: lib/contracts.ts: export the types Role ('mieszkaniec'|'ngo'|'jst'|'ekspert'|'rops'); Obszar (the 9 ROPS library categories plus 'Inne'): Dzieci, młodzież i rodzina | Seniorzy | Osoby z niepełnosprawnością sensoryczną | Osoby o ograniczonej mobilności | Osoby z niepełnosprawnością intelektualną | Zdrowie i medycyna | Cudzoziemcy | Rynek pracy | Osoby w kryzysie bezdomności | Inne; and OBSZARY const. Innovation (matches the DB innovations row, camelCase). Structured {obszar: Obszar; grupaDocelowa: string[]; slowaKluczowe: string[]; skala: 'jedna osoba'|'rodzina'|'społeczność lokalna'|'gmina'|'region'; podsumowanie: string; pytania: {pytanie: string; opcje: string[]}[]}. Candidate {id; score; bm25Rank?; denseRank?; matchedTerms: string[]}. MatchLabel 'Bardzo pasuje'|'Pasuje'|'Może pasować'. Pick {id; label: MatchLabel; dlaczego: string[]; dopasowaneSlowa: string[]; coDostosowac: string}. MatchInput {text; gminaTeryt?; onBehalf?: boolean; helperRole?: string; answers?: Record<string,string>}. MatchResult {reportId; structured; picks: Pick[]; candidates: Candidate[]; luka: boolean}. Fiszka {tytul; naCzymPolega; dlaKogo; problem; etap}. Kanwa {problem; odbiorcy; rozwiazanie; zmiana; innowacyjnosc; skala; zasobyKoszty; zespol}. IwsCriterion (5 names). IwsScores Record<IwsCriterion, number>. IwsAssessment {scores; uzasadnienia: Record<IwsCriterion,string>; verdict: {pass: boolean; reasons: string[]}; doPoprawy: string[]}. InstitutionProfile {typ: 'OPS'|'CUS'|'gmina'|'NGO'|'szkoła'|'DPS'|'inna'; gminaTeryt; wielkosc: string; budzetPln?: number; kadra?: string; partnerzy?: string}. ServiceCard {rdzen: string[]; doDostosowania: string[]; kroki: {krok: string; miesiac: string}[]; role: string[]; kosztyOrientacyjne: string; partnerzy: string[]; ryzyka: string[]; wskazniki: string[]; zrodlaFinansowania: string[]}. UwCheck {route: 'A'|'B'|'niekwalifikowane'; checklist: {item: string; stan: 'macie'|'brakuje'|'do ustalenia'}[]; nextStep: string; sourceUrl: string; caveat: string}. LocalContext {gmina; powiat; rows: {label; value; regionAvg; unit; source; year}[]}. NotificationType. lib/ai/models.ts: MODELS {fast: env AI_MODEL_FAST ?? 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5', smart: env AI_MODEL_SMART ?? 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5', embed: env AI_MODEL_EMBED ?? 'alibaba/qwen3-embedding-8b'}. lib/ai/gateway.ts: aiObject<T>({kind, tier: 'fast'|'smart', schema (zod), system, prompt, offline: () => T}), aiText({kind, tier, system, prompt, offline}), embedTexts(texts) → number[][] | null. When process.env.AI_MODE==='off', return offline() or null. Use the AI SDK generateObject/generateText/embedMany with gateway model strings. Log every call via lib/ai/audit.ts logAi() (inserts into ai_audit, and never throws). lib/session.ts: getSession() (cookie iskra_sid + iskra_role, default mieszkaniec), setRole server action, requireRole('rops'). lib/data.ts: loaders for data/corpus.json, data/teryt.json, data/powiaty.json, data/challenges.json (tolerate missing files by returning []). STUBS: create each of these with the exact signature and a fixture or empty return plus a '// STUB – replaced by <WP>' comment: lib/match/redact.ts redact(text) → {text, found} (M1); lib/match/structure.ts structureProblem(text, ctx?) → Promise<Structured> (M2); lib/match/retrieve.ts retrieve(q:{text; structured?}, k?) → Promise<Candidate[]> (M3); lib/match/rerank.ts rerank(text, structured, candidates) → Promise<Pick[]> (M4); lib/match/gap.ts isGap(picks, candidates) → boolean (M5); lib/match/index.ts runMatch(input) → Promise<MatchResult> (M5); lib/notify.ts notify({recipient,type,ref,title}), emailSim({toLabel,subject,body}), unreadCount(recipient) (C1); lib/iws.ts IWS_CRITERIA, passes(scores) (K1); lib/prescore.ts prescoreIdea(fiszka, kanwa?) → Promise<IwsAssessment> (K4); lib/uw.ts checkUw(profile, innovation) → UwCheck (W3); lib/middleman.ts buildServiceCard(innovation, profile) → Promise<ServiceCard> (W2); lib/local-context.ts localContext(gminaTeryt) → LocalContext|null (U6). Component stubs (default export, typed props, rendering null or a simple placeholder): components/shell/Bell.tsx (C1, owned by C1 after F1 imports it), components/voice/MicButton.tsx {onTranscript(text)} (U2), components/voice/ReadAloudButton.tsx {text} (U2), components/SimplifyButton.tsx {text} (U5), components/zglos/LocalContextStrip.tsx {gminaTeryt} (U6), components/zglos/Clarify.tsx {pytania, onDone(answers)} (U3), components/tester/TesterWidget.tsx {innovationId} (T1), components/wdrozenie/UwPanel.tsx {check: UwCheck} (W4). ROUTE SKELETONS: create page.tsx for each route below, rendering <PageHeader title='…'/> plus 'W przygotowaniu' so nav works: / ; /zglos ; /zglos/wyniki/[id] ; /zglos/wyniki/[id]/kartka ; /biblioteka ; /biblioteka/[id] ; /wyzwania ; /wiedza ; /pomysl ; /pomysl/[id]/kanwa ; /pomysl/[id]/ocena ; /pomysl/[id]/wniosek ; /wdrozenie ; /wdrozenie/[id] ; /testuj ; /wiadomosci ; /wiadomosci/[id] ; /admin ; /admin/trendy ; /admin/luki ; /admin/biblioteka ; /admin/biblioteka/[id] ; /admin/nabory ; /admin/poczta ; /admin/testy ; /admin/koszty-ai ; /dostepnosc ; /o-projekcie ; /etr ; /pjm. Public pages live under app/(public)/. scripts/smoke-ai.ts: one aiText in Polish plus one embedTexts, printing the text and dim=N (this is Gate G0).
wps.verify: pnpm check:owned lib/ components/ app/; every route above returns 200 through curl; pnpm tsx scripts/smoke-ai.ts prints Polish text and dim>0 (G0). If it fails, report it and the lead sets AI_MODE=off.

wps.title: Data build: corpus, TERYT, powiaty, challenges, PII and licence audit
wps.spec: Copy {research}/data/*.json|csv and {research}/rops-biblioteka-innowacji.json into data/raw/. scripts/build-corpus.ts merges data/raw/innovations.json (items), innovations_rops_sections.json (items) and rops-biblioteka-innowacji.json (video, materials_zip, selected_for_dissemination by slug or url) into data/corpus.json: an array of 115 Innovation objects (camelCase as in lib/contracts.ts). obszar maps from thematic_area onto the Obszar list ('Dla cudzoziemców' → 'Cudzoziemcy'). evidence = 'Rekomendowana do upowszechniania' if selected, else 'Przetestowana w inkubatorze ROPS'. sections = the 5 ROPS fields ONLY for CC BY entries; the 15 without a licence mark get sections:null and licence:'brak oznaczenia licencji'. Attribution 'Źródło: ROPS Kraków, Biblioteka Innowacji Społecznych (CC BY 4.0)' where applicable. Also emit data/teryt.json (gminas + powiats from teryt_malopolska.csv), data/powiaty.json (from powiaty_indicators.csv, numbers parsed, plus a Małopolska average row id '12'), data/challenges.json (normalised 8 areas: id, nazwa, definicja, wyzwania[], zrodlo) and data/synthetic.json (from synthetic_problems.json, keeping synthetic:true). PII audit: regex for phone numbers, e-mails, PESEL and 'imię nazwisko'-like capitalised pairs in all text fields. Write docs/data-audit.md with counts and a 10-record spot check, and remove any personal names found from corpus text.
wps.verify: node -e "const c=require('./data/corpus.json');if(c.length!==115)process.exit(1)"; every record has sourceUrl, licence and a valid obszar; the audit reports 0 phones and 0 e-mails; data/powiaty.json has 23 rows (22 + average).

wps.title: PII redaction
wps.spec: redact(text) masks PESEL (11 digits, checksum optional) as [PESEL], phones (PL formats incl. +48, spaces and dashes) as [TELEFON], e-mails as [EMAIL], IBAN/account numbers as [KONTO], street address patterns 'ul. X 12/3' as [ADRES], and ID card numbers 'ABC123456' as [DOWÓD]. Returns {text, found: string[] of kinds}. Ordinary text stays unchanged.
wps.verify: pnpm vitest run lib/match/redact.test.ts with ≥10 fixtures (positive and negative) passes; pnpm check:owned lib/match/redact.ts.

wps.title: Problem structuring (LLM)
wps.spec: structureProblem(text, ctx) uses aiObject (tier fast) with a zod schema matching Structured. obszar is a z.enum over OBSZARY. slowaKluczowe are 5–12 Polish lemmas (base forms) plus synonyms. pytania holds at most 2 clarifying questions, each with ≤4 options plus 'Nie wiem', only when ambiguous. System prompt in Polish: a social-policy analyst at ROPS Kraków who never invents facts. Offline fallback: keyword rules mapping words to obszar (e.g. senior|starsz|emeryt → Seniorzy), slowaKluczowe = top content words with a 6-char prefix.
wps.verify: vitest with a mocked gateway: the schema accepts the mock and the offline fallback maps 'Moja mama ma 82 lata i jest samotna' → Seniorzy. One live call on data/synthetic.json syn-001 returns obszar Seniorzy (record the result).

wps.title: Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense + RRF)
wps.spec: Build the MiniSearch index lazily from getCorpus() over title^3, keywords^2, summary, problem, targetGroups and sections text. processTerm: lowercase, then emit both the diacritics-stripped token and stem(token) (a 6-char prefix, in lib/match/stem.ts), dropping a Polish stopword list. Search uses fuzzy 0.2, prefix true, and the query is the text plus structured.slowaKluczowe. Dense: if data/corpus.embedded.json exists, embed the query via embedTexts and take cosine top 20; if not, skip dense. Tag boost: +1 rank bucket when obszar matches structured.obszar. Fuse with RRF k=60 and return the top k (default 10) Candidates with matchedTerms (the query terms found in the doc).
wps.verify: vitest (offline, no embeddings): 'samotność seniorów na wsi' → the top 10 contain ≥1 Seniorzy item; 'dziecko w spektrum autyzmu w szkole' → the top 10 contain an item whose targetGroups or keywords mention autyzm or niepełnosprawność. The test also passes with AI_MODE=off.

wps.title: Rerank + explanation with ID guard
wps.spec: rerank(text, structured, candidates) sends the top 10 candidates (id, title, summary, targetGroups, whoCanUse) to aiObject (tier fast). Schema: picks array (max 5) whose id is z.enum(candidateIds), so the model CANNOT return an unknown id; label is MatchLabel; dlaczego holds ≤2 plain-Polish bullets of ≤15 words; dopasowaneSlowa; coDostosowac is 1 sentence. Return [] if none fit. Server-side, re-check that every id is in candidates. Offline fallback: the top 3 candidates labelled by rank (Pasuje / Może pasować) with dlaczego built from matchedTerms ('Pasujące słowa: …').
wps.verify: vitest: a mocked model output with a non-candidate id fails schema parsing (the guard works); the offline fallback returns ≤3 picks with ids ⊂ candidates.

wps.title: Match orchestrator + gap + submitReport action
wps.spec: runMatch(input): redact → structureProblem → retrieve → rerank → isGap (luka when there are no picks, OR every pick is 'Może pasować', OR the top candidate score is below a threshold) → insert the report (text_redacted, structured, picks, candidate_ids, luka, gmina/powiat teryt from data/teryt.json, on_behalf, helper_role, session_id) → notify({recipient:'rops', type: luka ? 'luka' : 'nowe_zgloszenie', ref: reportId, title}) → return MatchResult. Server action submitReport(formData) calls runMatch and redirects to /zglos/wyniki/[id]. lib/db/q/reports.ts exports getReport(id), listReports(filters) and setReportStatus(id, status).
wps.verify: vitest with all deps mocked: luka logic on 3 fixtures. Live: a tsx one-off calling runMatch on syn-003 returns ≥1 pick and inserts a row (print the reportId).

wps.title: Build-time embeddings
wps.spec: Embed title + summary + problem + targetGroups + keywords for all 115 corpus items with embedTexts, in batches of 32. Write data/corpus.embedded.json as [{id, v:number[]}] and corpus.meta.json as {model, dim, date, count}. Also update the innovations.embedding column for each row (an update loop; skip the DB if no rows exist yet). If AI_MODE=off or the call fails, write meta {skipped:true} and exit 0.
wps.verify: count==115, all vectors the same dim, no NaN (asserted by the script), meta.dim>0, or meta.skipped=true with the reason printed.

wps.title: Intake wizard /zglos (Krok 1–3 flow)
wps.spec: Per research 05 §3.3. Krok 1 z 2: h1 'Opisz problem własnymi słowami'. A large Textarea (label 'Co się dzieje? Kogo to dotyczy?', hint with an example) and <MicButton onTranscript> that appends editable text and NEVER auto-submits. Topic chips (Samotność, Opieka nad bliskim, Dojazd, Praca, Niepełnosprawność, Młodzież) that prefill the text. An optional GminaPicker (an accessible combobox over data/teryt.json gminas, with typed filter and a listbox, or a native <select> grouped by powiat if faster). A 'Pomagam komuś' checkbox that reveals 'Kim jesteś dla tej osoby?' (opiekun/rodzina/pracownik socjalny/sąsiad/inna) and switches the copy to third person. A notice 'Nie podawaj danych osobowych'. Then a Krok 2 z 2 confirmation, or straight submit via the submitReport action (M5) with a pending state ('Szukam rozwiązań…' in StatusRegion). 'Wstecz' keeps the input. Autosave the draft to localStorage (try/catch). Clarify questions (U3) are optional: if structured.pytania is non-empty, the results page shows them instead.
wps.verify: curl /zglos → 200 with the h1 text; e2e/U1.spec.ts: a keyboard-only fill and submit lands on /zglos/wyniki/<id>, and axeCheck passes on /zglos.

wps.title: Voice: speech input + read aloud
wps.spec: MicButton: render ONLY if window.SpeechRecognition || webkitSpeechRecognition exists. lang pl-PL, interimResults; button text 'Powiedz zamiast pisać', then 'Słucham… (kliknij, aby zakończyć)'; announce state via StatusRegion; a privacy hint 'Rozpoznawanie mowy realizuje przeglądarka (Google/Apple).'; onTranscript(final text). ReadAloudButton: speechSynthesis with a pl-PL voice if available, toggling 'Przeczytaj na głos' / 'Zatrzymaj czytanie', cancelling on unmount, hidden if speechSynthesis is unsupported.
wps.verify: vitest jsdom: with SpeechRecognition undefined, MicButton renders nothing; with a stubbed speechSynthesis, clicking ReadAloudButton calls speak with lang pl-PL.

wps.title: Clarifying questions component
wps.spec: Clarify {pytania, onDone(answers)}: one question at a time (fieldset/legend + RadioGroup + an always-present 'Nie wiem / Pomiń'), 'Dalej' and 'Wstecz', with StepIndicator 'Pytanie X z Y'. On finish, call onDone. On the results page it appears above the cards as 'Doprecyzuj, żeby wyniki były trafniejsze (opcjonalnie)', and the answers re-run the match through a server action owned by U4.
wps.verify: vitest: 2 questions → onDone receives both answers; keyboard navigation works (radio arrows).

wps.title: Results page /zglos/wyniki/[id]
wps.spec: Load the report (lib/db/q/reports getReport) and corpus items for the picks. Header 'Znaleźliśmy N rozwiązań' plus a StatusRegion message. A summary of the understood problem (structured.podsumowanie plus obszar and grupa chips, with a link 'Coś się nie zgadza? Opisz inaczej'). <LocalContextStrip gminaTeryt>. A list of ResultCards: h2 title, summary, label badge (Bardzo pasuje / Pasuje / Może pasować, as text, not colour alone), evidence badge, 'Dlaczego to pasuje?' bullets, 'Co trzeba dostosować', and the source link with licence. Buttons: <ReadAloudButton>, <SimplifyButton text>, 'Wdróż u siebie' → /wdrozenie?innowacja=ID&raport=RID, 'Zapytaj pracownika ROPS' → a server action that creates a thread (subject report) then redirects to /wiadomosci/[id], 'Szczegóły' → /biblioteka/ID. Everything AI-generated is wrapped in AiLabel. If luka: a Notice 'Nie znaleźliśmy dobrze pasującego rozwiązania' plus 'Zgłoś pomysł' → /pomysl?z=RID, and 'Twoja potrzeba trafi do ROPS jako sygnał'. 'Wydrukuj kartkę' → ./kartka. If pytania exist, render <Clarify> whose onDone posts answers to a re-run action (runMatch with answers) and redirects to the new report.

Write docs/eval.md: a method paragraph, a results table, the 3 worst cases with an explanation, and an honest note on weak corpus areas (poverty, depopulation, homelessness).
